correctness.rationale: For the full (not pure) strong discrete-Morse matching complex of unfilled C3 vee C_n on one hub, the unique-earlier-neighbor criterion was reconstructed and all (n+2)! vertex orders enumerated for n=3,4,5,6. Independently generated facet counts [24,42,68,104], nonempty faces [36,104,292,764], and exact acyclic Morse face pairs [11,48,142,375], with critical cells respectively {0:1,1:13}, {0:1,2:7}, {0:1,2:7}, {0:1,2:2,3:11}. Independently checked reversed Hasse diagram acyclic and exact signed integral Morse differential zero. Since no critical 1-cells and pi2(S² vee S²)=Z², zero degree-3-to-2 integer attaching degrees imply 11 nullhomotopic 3-cells, proving n6 wedge 2 S² vee11 S³. Other cases follow similarly. Finite domain exhausted.

value.rationale: Vertex-gluing nonidentical cycle petals is a natural first gap after all-triangle and all-square strong-Morse formulas. The exhaustively classified initial lengths isolate a genuine topological transition: mixed degree-2 and degree-3 sphere summands coexist at n=6, unlike earlier single-degree rows. Exact zero signed attaching degrees give stronger integral homotopy than Betti numbers alone and supply a useful constrained test case for cactus-gluing structure.
residual_risks: No general all-cycle-length formula or functorial splitting.

limitations: Complete Knudson–Owens-White manuscript was inaccessible, retained priority risk; does not automatically negate O.
